user.title: Traccar sync settings
user.description: Disabled by default. Token status: {token_status}. Positions use OsmAnd; the token is sent only to the web API. Changing settings pauses history imports.

data.token: API token (leave blank to keep configured token)
data.devices: iCloud3 devices (empty means all current devices)

error.permission: The token needs device read/create/update and history read permissions.
error.unavailable: Cannot reach Traccar. Check the URL and network.
error.invalid_response: Unexpected server response; verify the API URL.
error.invalid_url: Use an HTTP(S) URL without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
error.missing_connection: Supply both URLs and the API token, or leave all empty and keep sync disabled.
error.invalid_range: Use an increasing time range with an explicit UTC offset, ending in the past.
error.no_devices: Select existing, enabled iCloud3 device trackers.
error.invalid_batch_size: Batch size must be between 1 and 1000.
error.history_running: A history import is already running.
error.history_pending: Resume or cancel the paused history job first.
error.device_not_found: Traccar device or API endpoint was not found.
error.duplicate_device: Several devices have the same uniqueId; resolve this on Traccar first.
